name: scenario-to-android
description: Operator CLI surface. The standard flat status command is cataloged as local because cli-core owns its implementation rather than a scenario Connect service. The Android delivery-ramp group is hand-registered because its REST control surfaces and durable matrix lifecycle are not Connect-RPC bindings.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show scenario API health and lifecycle state.

groups.name: android
groups.description: Operate the Android delivery ramp. These commands are hand-registered because they drive REST control surfaces and durable matrix operations rather than Connect-RPC methods.

commands.name: targets
commands.description: Probe local, emulator, physical, and bridge Android targets.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Render a generated Capacitor Android project without building artifacts.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build a debug APK and AAB from a scenario web bundle.

commands.name: signing-provision
commands.description: Generate and store the Android upload key through secrets-manager.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Build, install, drive, and record one server-owned Android validation run.

commands.name: conformance-plan
commands.description: Show the generated-app Android conformance chapters.

commands.name: readiness
commands.description: Show the six-rung Google release readiness ladder.

commands.name: distribution
commands.description: Show independent Play, sideload, and ADB channels.

commands.name: matrix-catalog
commands.description: Show the durable Android validation catalog.

commands.name: matrix-create
commands.description: Create a normal-profile Android validation matrix.

commands.name: matrix-start
commands.description: Start a server-owned Android validation matrix.

commands.name: matrix-wait
commands.description: Wait for a server-owned Android validation matrix.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare two durable Android validation matrix runs.

commands.name: evidence-paths
commands.description: Print the absolute physical and emulator evidence paths.
